title: Flexible pages: your QA

short.lead: A page can now take any format that meets seven basics, and the page check reads it instead of refusing it for lacking the builder's mark; three tests are yours.
short.hint: Tap a row to see what was run and what it showed.
items: Full hook checks: verify.py passes 1294 of 1294
Run in this cloud session on 2026-11-19, after the branch was picked up. tools/verify_tools.py passes 54 of 54 and docs_drift.py finds 0 stale citations.

page_criteria.py on a hand-made QA page: with two wrong marker names it named both and exited 1; with them fixed it printed 'all basics met', and --visual showed no overflow at 375px in light and dark.
Run python tools/use_branch.py ajsagent/sharp-edison-y4xjzv from the repo root. Expect it to report version 2.82.0 installed.
A hand-made page missing a basic is refused once

In a new session, ask for a short page written by hand (not with make_page.py) under docs/plans/ that has no tick-box checklist. Expect one refusal that names the missing checklist, then a pass once it is added.
A starter writes a skeleton page
Run make_page.py start qa. Expect the message 'wrote the qa starter to ...qa.page.json'. The file is a skeleton with <replace: ...> fields.

wrapup.summary: Flexible pages are built as house-rules 2.82.0 and wait for your QA.
wrapup.changing: The page check, the new checker, the starters, the page rule text and the flexible pages systems doc.
wrapup.next: On a pass I open a pull request into main. On a fail I fix it on this branch.
